sections.content: Report from dashboard: Configuration. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select distinct s.servername , s.is_active , s.server  "ip address"    , s.db_vendor
from metrics.servers s 
left outer join   metrics.servers_routines sr on s.row_id = sr.server_id
left outer join metrics."routines" r on r.row_id = sr.routine_id
where routine_name  not  IN('collect_all_metrics_postgres_queries','collect_all_metrics_mssql_queries','collect_all_metrics_mysql_queries')
